title: Credit Limits, Holds and Payment Plans: Home Delivery Pharmacy Billing Terms Schedule
content:
## Billing terms by program

The Home Delivery Pharmacy account carries a running balance due. This schedule gives, per program, the figures that govern how large that balance may grow, how long a held order waits, and whether the balance may be spread over a payment plan.

| | Voluntary | Standard | Maintenance 90 | Advantage | Maintenance Choice | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Credit limit: balance the account may carry (USD) | 100.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 | 300.00 |
| Calendar days an order may stay held for payment before it is cancelled (hold date is day zero) | 14 | 14 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 30 |
| Payment plan offered | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Smallest balance due that qualifies for a payment plan (USD) | 0.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 100.00 |
| Program's maximum plan length (monthly installments) | 0 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 12 |
| Orders not held for balance while a payment plan is in good standing | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Automatic retries of a declined card before the account is placed on hold | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| HSA and FSA debit cards accepted | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Balance statement while a balance is due | Monthly | Monthly | Monthly | Monthly | Monthly | Monthly |

### Notes

1. Where no payment plan is offered (Northbridge Home Delivery Voluntary), the minimum balance and the maximum plan length are shown as 0.00 and 0.
2. An order whose charge would take the balance due above the credit limit is held; the 14, 21 or 30 day figure counts calendar days from the hold date, the hold date itself being day zero.

### Boundary illustration (hypothetical balances)

- Under Northbridge Home Delivery Premier a balance due of exactly 100.00 meets the 100.00 payment-plan threshold; 99.99 does not.
- Under Northbridge Home Delivery Maintenance 90 a balance due of 150.00 meets the threshold and 149.99 does not.
- An order placed on hold on a day zero under Standard reaches its fourteenth calendar day fourteen days later.
